text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert - billing pipeline: emitter heartbeat split detected. Shadow aggregator lag > 30m, some usage batches delayed, transient overage flags firing. Investigating.
oncall-elaine: Ack. I'm on it. Which regions and customers are we seeing? :eyes:
sre-aaron: Looking at metrics now. Kafka consumer for meter-emitter-2 shows offset gap around 6632101200-6632103000, consumer group lag spiking.
billing-ops-maya: Early sweep: ~120 customers flagged as overage in the last 20m, most are small dev accounts but a handful enterprise. Attaching quick counts: total tokens in shadow backlog ~1.8M, current live emitted tokens ~900k.
oncall-elaine: Thanks Maya. Priority: stop noisy overage emails and prevent automated billing triggers while we triage. Can we mute alerts?
pm-jane: Please do not automatically refund yet — need scope first. We should notify CS for affected paying customers.
eng-runtime-raj: Possible cause: heartbeat split between region-a and region-b where emitter instances failed to heartbeat to the aggregator; fallback batching retried and doubled counts in some windows. I can run a quick KV-cache check.
sre-aaron: Run this to see consumer backlog: ``kafka-consumer-groups --describe --group meter-emitter-2 --bootstrap-server kafka.prod:9092``
billing-ops-maya: Running now. Output snippet: ``CURRENT-LAG 34567 partitions_stalled: 4``. Also seeing intermittent 429s from the emit API at 6632103100.
oncall-elaine: Action items: 1) mute automated overage emails (Maya) 2) pause billing triggers (Maya + Aaron) 3) run shadow-agg replay safely (Raj) 4) CS notify affected customers (Oli)
sre-aaron: I'm going to temporarily pause the consumer rebalances to allow controlled replay. Will flip the flag: ``/opt/ops/bin/consumer-pause --group meter-emitter-2``
eng-runtime-raj: I'll spin a read-only aggregator instance and run dedupe on the backlog before re-emitting. Plan: dedupe by event-id and timestamp window, then apply rate cap.
billing-ops-maya: Muting alerts and pausing auto-triggers now. :white_check_mark: Stopping notification webhook to billing-notify queue.
customer-success-oli: Drafting a short post to affected customers: "We detected delayed usage reporting; you may see transient overage flags which we are suppressing while we reconcile. No action required from you." Will flag high-touch accounts for outreach.
oncall-elaine: ETA for safe replay?
eng-runtime-raj: Est ~25 min to run dedupe and replay for current backlog, will stream progress logs. Starting job now.
sre-aaron: Watchdog: I'll monitor replication lag and consumer offsets, and enable automatic fallback to standby aggregator if lag increases.
incident-bot: Note: paging escalation rules applied: oncall->sre->eng-runtime.
pm-jane: For postmortem: capture root cause, timeline, and customer impact matrix. Assign to eng-runtime and billing-ops.
oncall-elaine: Good. Quick status in 10m please. If we see recurring heartbeat splits, we may need evasive infra change.
eng-runtime-raj: 10m update: dedupe pass complete, replay started, rate-limited to 50 rps. Re-emitting first windows now.
billing-ops-maya: Reconciliation in progress. Overages suppressed. Early reconciliation shows 0.1% net token inflation after dedupe (i.e., small net increase vs live).
sre-aaron: Consumer lag trending down to 1200. No new 429s in the last 3 minutes.
oncall-elaine: Great. Keep CS updated and don't re-enable billing triggers until confirmation.
customer-success-oli: Notifying top 12 affected accounts, adding contact list for follow-ups.
eng-runtime-raj: Replay finished. Final check: dedupe removed ~95k duplicate tokens, backlog cleared. Pushing final reconciliation to billing pipeline.
billing-ops-maya: Final: no customer charges were applied during suppression window. We'll run full audit job overnight and surface any anomalies to finance tomorrow.
pm-jane: Thanks team. Post-incident: create ticket BI-663210 for follow-up actions (alert tuning, heartbeat guard, replay playbook updates).
oncall-elaine: Closing live mitigation. If anyone sees regression, reopen thread. :thumbsup:
